Promote Nxeon to production. LOCAL deploy (prod at /opt/nxeon, services nxeon-web + nxeon-worker). User has authorized autonomous promotion of this pipeline. /opt/nxeon is on main at commit a4c1f3f "Add Cold Email Engine Phase 2". This adds ADDITIVE schema changes (new columns on Brand/ColdCampaign/ColdSend/SequenceStep/EmailEvent, new EmailEventType values, a unique constraint on ColdSend, and ColdSend.trackingToken unique). ColdSend/EmailEvent are empty in prod (nothing has ever sent), so the unique constraints apply cleanly.

Run IN ORDER, STOP on any failure and report the error + `journalctl` tail:
1. `cd /opt/nxeon && git rev-parse HEAD` (must be a4c1f3f...) and `git status --short` (clean). If not, STOP.
2. `cd /opt/nxeon && npx prisma db push` (NO --accept-data-loss). Expect additive success, exit 0. If Prisma refuses due to data loss / wants to drop anything, STOP — do NOT force, report what it wanted to drop.
3. `cd /opt/nxeon && bash scripts/promote-production.sh`. Must end "Production promote complete", HTTP 200. On "PRODUCTION UNHEALTHY", STOP + report `journalctl -u nxeon-web -n 40 --no-pager`.
4. Verify (report each code):
   - `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1/` (expect 200)
   - `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "Host: 4j3d7gkr2wcbi34.nxeon.cloud" http://127.0.0.1/admin/coldemail` (expect 200 or 3xx, NOT 404/500)
   - `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1/api/coldemail/track/open/bogustoken` (expect 200 — always returns the pixel)
   - `systemctl is-active nxeon-web nxeon-worker`
5. CRITICAL — confirm sending is OFF in prod (must not have been enabled): 
   `cd /opt/nxeon && node -e "const{PrismaClient}=require('@prisma/client');const p=new PrismaClient();p.setting.findUnique({where:{key:'cold_email_sending_enabled'}}).then(r=>{console.log('cold_email_sending_enabled =',r?r.value:'UNSET(off)');process.exit(0)}).catch(e=>{console.log('err',e.message);process.exit(0)})"`
   Report the value. Do NOT change it.

Do NOT edit code/env/git history. Report concisely: HEAD, db push result, promote result, the verification codes, and the sending-flag value.
